scenes.hold: the title and the four opening words over the long instrumental: one breath of wind crossing one still plain, in one take
one walk along the drying bricks to the kilns: the verse is one morning's work
one climb up the tower's ramp for the whole chorus
one track along the wall as it rises course by course
one crane up the tower's face, a terrace per line, into the cloud
the silence and the descent of the light are one held moment
one slow descent through the storm cloud while the words are spoken
one move back from the wall as the words break and the storm takes them
one walk through the abandoned site after the storm
one glide upstream past the first camps
one accelerating glide upstream as the days run faster
one move from the dawn ridge to the ash and back
one drift along the river bank at Ur
one walk along the tracks leaving Ur
one move past the well to the cairn
the last line and the end title over the long outro: one rise over the road going on
